name: guard-sweep-expensive-steps-are-gated
breaks: the sweep's shards start whether or not there is anything to prove, so a day with no merges starts a macOS runner per shard and pays a whole billed minute for each at a ten times multiplier, which is what the gate was measured to save (#989, #1259, #1348). The gate is a JOB now rather than a step, so the perturbation is the job's condition: it was the `if:` on one costly step until #1348 removed the per-shard check that condition read
